Evelyn / Marissa — quick technical ops note for pricing and lead time calc:

- If Greenfield wants fully isolated VPCs in a separate AWS account, plan for ~8-10 business days for onboarding + IAM/KMS setup and 3-4 additional days for network validation.
- If same AWS account / different VPC with strict subnet and routing controls, we can do ~5 business days.
- For SOC2-friendly log separation, we recommend customer-managed Kinesis or a dedicated logging endpoint with separate S3 buckets + per-cluster prefixes; Redwood can route logs but customer's KMS is required for full separation.
- GPU sizing: you mentioned matching current profile (A100x2 equivalent). For two clusters procured as reserved capacity, we can offer stepped discounts at 12 and 24 months.

I'll attach a short checklist for the network team.

Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposal: term options + cluster add (GF-2027-REN-42)

Hi Aiden — attaching a short proposal (PDF) and the network checklist Sean referenced. High-level:

- Option A (12 months): renew current environment + add 2 isolated VPC clusters (A100x2 equiv)
  • Incremental annual cost for two clusters: $178,000
  • Standard onboarding lead time: 10 business days (separate account); 6 business days (same account, new VPC)
  • No-term discount

- Option B (24 months): renew + add 2 clusters, 24-month reserved capacity
  • Incremental annual cost: $150,000 (effective pricing w/ 24-mo reserve)
  • Includes 7% platform credit applied to usage metering
  • Onboarding lead time same as above

- Security & compliance: we will require customer-managed KMS keys for log separation. Sean's checklist is attached.

Next steps: 1) Confirm preferred term (12 vs 24), 2) confirm account vs VPC separation, 3) sign attached amendment (DocuSign link provided) or we can route through procurement. If you confirm by April 16 we can guarantee the 24-month pricing for your renewal date.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if it helps.

Best,
Evelyn

If those two items are OK we will execute the DocuSign this week.
